The Idea in One Picture

The value goes down

Along the closed loop the value $V(x_k)$ falls to zero (Fig. [[fig:concept]]). [[citet:mayne2000]] state the general conditions; here everything is scalar.

The equation and the numbers

With $a=1.2$, $b=q=r=1$, the Riccati equation gives $P$ and the gain $K$, and the Bellman equation reads

$$ V(x_{k+1})-V(x_k)+\ell(x_k,u_k)=0,\qquad u_k=-Kx_k. \tag{[[eq:bellman]]} $$
QuantityValue
$P$1.952234
$K$0.793528
$a-bK$0.406472
What is established.
  • verified Equation ([[eq:bellman]]) holds to rounding error on 20 steps (Section [[sec:sec-verification]]).
